ablation.notes: Variant F plus content-adaptive VQ atom logits. Tests whether content-adaptive style atom routing can keep F's LPIPS-preserving easy-to-hard internal VAE-latent queue curriculum while improving style. No DINO, CLIP supervision, classifier, or external semantic features.
